To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the notion of shadow circuits, as we have defined and used it in our research, is useful in the analysis of complex, stratify societies, mobile societies and the Mediterranean.
shadow circuits, which connect distant places in the Mediterranean and beyond, are the key to understanding complex, stratified, mobile societies.

(1) shadow circuits are a key element of contemporary urban societies; (2) they are a major source of urban transformation; (3) they are the main driver of the transformation of the Mediterranean into a globalized region; (4) they contribute to the understanding and the study of complex, stratify societies; and (5) they contribute to our understanding of the relationship between mobility and diversity.

how the social and cultural practices of mobility are changing the urban spaces of Turin and of Naples.
the relationship between the urban space and mobilities in the Mediterranean area.
the relationship between the social construction and the social reality of diversity.
